source.snippet: I want this so badly. If Anthropic released this I would start using it on day one. If they launched a GitHub competitor built around it I would pay for it on day one.

problem_statement: Developers want source control tooling natively integrated with AI-assisted coding workflows; existing Git/GitHub paradigms were not designed for AI-generated diffs, multi-agent commits, or prompt-driven branching, leaving a gap that practitioners are actively willing to pay to fill.
target_segment: Software engineers and engineering teams using AI coding assistants daily who find Git workflows mismatched to AI-generated code patterns.
notes: Explicit 'I would pay for it on day one' from an HN commenter on a post about Anthropic redesigning source control. Single signal but unusually direct buyer intent. Watch for corroborating signals from r/programming or dev.to. Buyer: individual software engineer with purchasing autonomy for SaaS tools.
